title: PRD0062 34A — Model and edit nested Book schedules

scheduleModel: One final due date plus stable structural-node release/deadline rules.
Nearest-ancestor release and deadline resolve independently.
Nested deadlines may equal but cannot exceed the parent or final due date.
Open access creates no prerequisite graph and overdue content remains accessible.
Later per-student extensions win with an auditable explanation.
teacherIntent: Add, extend, shorten, remove, and unchanged deadline intents are typed.
Unknown affected-student state fails closed for add/shorten.
The typed preview handoff carries deadline mutation intents to ticket 33D.
Book edits cannot enter the legacy partial-write path; the shared warning announcement is emitted.
Legacy one-level Homework updates remain unchanged.
scopeSafety: Activity targets without placement IDs resolve only when the Activity placement is unique.
Unavailable or ambiguous exact targets do not widen to whole-Book scope.
Rules and mutation intents outside a newly selected manifest scope are filtered before handoff.

verification.typecheckContext: The broad repository typecheck has pre-existing diagnostics in unrelated dirty Book Assembly/runtime paths; no diagnostic names a ticket-83-owned path.

currentSourcePreview.build: Harness Vite build --mode test into an isolated temporary outDir
currentSourcePreview.serve: Harness Vite preview from that exact outDir on localhost:5173

desktop.handoff: Read-only handoff prepared for 2 Activity record(s).

repairs: Removed hidden out-of-scope rules after scope changes.
Carried typed mutation intent through the ticket-33B handoff to ticket 33D.
Made unknown student state fail closed.
Used the shared warning announcement for denied Book edits.

rollback.behavior: The existing final Homework due date remains authoritative; nested rules remain preserved but unused.
